description_en: Modifies the attributes of a scaling group to automatically adjust computing capacity by adding or removing instances based on business needs and policies. If the current attributes no longer meet business requirements, this operation allows you to modify attributes such as the maximum, minimum, or expected number of instances without recreating the scaling group, saving time and resource costs
description_zh: 如果您需要根据业务变动需求与策略自动增加或减少指定类型的实例数量，则可以通过配置伸缩组来自动调整您的业务计算能力（即实例数量）。如果当前伸缩组属性不再满足业务需求，则您可以调用API ModifyScalingGroup修改伸缩组属性（例如最大实例数、最小实例数或期望实例数等属性），避免重新创建伸缩组并重新配置相关属性，节省了时间和资源成本
name: ModifyScalingGroup

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling group to be modified
parameters.help_zh: 待修改伸缩组的ID
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the scaling group. The name must be unique within a region. It must be 2 to 64 characters in length and start with a digit, letter, or Chinese character. It can contain digits, underscores (_), hyphens (-), and periods (.)
parameters.help_zh: 伸缩组的名称，同一地域下伸缩组名称唯一。长度为2~64个字符，以数字、大小英文字母或中文开头，可以包含数字、下划线（_）、短划线（-）和半角句号（.）
parameters.name: scaling_group_name

parameters.help_en:
The minimum number of ECS or ECI instances in the scaling group. When the number of ECS or ECI instances in the scaling group is less than the `MinSize` value, Auto Scaling automatically creates ECS or ECI instances.

The value of `MinSize` must be less than or equal to the value of `MaxSize`
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩组内ECS实例或ECI实例台数的最小值，当伸缩组内ECS或ECI实例数小于`MinSize`时，弹性伸缩会自动创建ECS实例或ECI实例。

`MinSize`的值必须小于或等于`MaxSize`的值
parameters.name: min_size

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of ECS or ECI instances in the scaling group. When the number of ECS or ECI instances in the scaling group is greater than the `MaxSize` value, Auto Scaling automatically removes ECS or ECI instances.

<props="china">The value range of MaxSize depends on your Auto Scaling usage. Go to the Quota Center (https://quotas.console.aliyun.com/products/ess/quotas) to view the quota value for the maximum number ECS instances in a single scaling group.</props>

<props="intl">The value range of MaxSize depends on your Auto Scaling usage. Go to the Quota Center (https://quotas.console.aliyun.com/products/ess/quotas) to view the quota value for the maximum number ECS instances in a single scaling group.</props>

<props="partner">The value range of MaxSize depends on your Auto Scaling usage. Go to the Quota Center to view the quota value for the maximum number ECS instances in a single scaling group.</props>

For example, if the quota value for the maximum number ECS instances in a single scaling group is 2000, the value range of `MaxSize` is 0 to 2000
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩组内ECS实例或ECI实例台数的最大值，当伸缩组内ECS或ECI实例数大于`MaxSize`时，弹性伸缩会自动移出ECS实例或ECI实例。

<props="china">MaxSize的取值范围和弹性伸缩使用情况有关，请前往配额中心 (https://quotas.console.aliyun.com/products/ess/quotas)查看单个伸缩组可以设置的组内最大实例数对应的配额值。</props>

<props="intl">MaxSize的取值范围和弹性伸缩使用情况有关，请前往配额中心 (https://quotas.console.aliyun.com/products/ess/quotas)查看单个伸缩组可以设置的组内最大实例数对应的配额值。</props>

<props="partner">MaxSize的取值范围和弹性伸缩使用情况有关，请前往配额中心查看单个伸缩组可以设置的组内最大实例数对应的配额值。</props>

例如，如果单个伸缩组可以设置的组内最大实例数对应的配额值为2000，则`MaxSize`的取值范围为0~2000
parameters.name: max_size

parameters.help_en:
The cooldown time after a scaling activity (adding or removing ECS or ECI instances) is completed. Valid values: 0 to 86400. Unit: seconds.

During the cooldown time, the scaling group does not execute other scaling activities. This parameter takes effect only for scaling activities triggered by CloudMonitor event-triggered tasks
parameters.help_zh:
一次伸缩活动（添加或移出ECS实例或ECI实例）结束后的一段冷却时间。取值范围：0~86400，单位：秒。

冷却时间内，该伸缩组不执行其他的伸缩活动，仅针对云监控报警任务触发的伸缩活动有效
parameters.name: default_cooldown

parameters.help_en:
The first scale-in policy used to remove ECS instances from the scaling group. Valid values:

OldestInstance: removes the ECS instances that were added to the scaling group at the earliest point in time.
NewestInstance: removes the ECS instances that were added to the scaling group at the latest point in time.
OldestScalingConfiguration: removes the ECS instances that were created based on the earliest scaling configuration.
CustomPolicy: removes ECS instances based on a custom scale-in policy defined by a Function Compute function.

The scaling configuration mentioned in OldestScalingConfiguration refers to the instance configuration source in the scaling group, which includes scaling configurations and launch templates. CustomPolicy can only be set as the first removal policy. If you specify CustomPolicy, you must also specify the CustomPolicyARN parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定移出ECS实例的第一段伸缩组策略。取值范围：

OldestInstance：移出最早加入伸缩组的ECS实例。
NewestInstance：移出最新加入伸缩组的ECS实例。
OldestScalingConfiguration：移出最早伸缩配置创建的ECS实例。
CustomPolicy：基于自定义缩容策略Function函数移除ECS实例。

OldestScalingConfiguration中提到的伸缩配置泛指组内实例配置信息来源，包括伸缩配置和启动模板。CustomPolicy仅支持设置为首位移除策略，当指定CustomPolicy需同时指定CustomPolicyARN参数
parameters.name: removal_policy_1

parameters.help_en:
The second scale-in policy used to remove ECS instances from the scaling group. Valid values:

OldestInstance: removes the ECS instances that were added to the scaling group at the earliest point in time.
NewestInstance: removes the ECS instances that were added to the scaling group at the latest point in time.
OldestScalingConfiguration: removes the ECS instances that were created based on the earliest scaling configuration.

The scaling configuration mentioned in OldestScalingConfiguration refers to the instance configuration source in the scaling group, which includes scaling configurations and launch templates
parameters.help_zh:
指定移出ECS实例的第二段伸缩组策略。取值范围：

OldestInstance：移出最早加入伸缩组的ECS实例。
NewestInstance：移出最新加入伸缩组的ECS实例。
OldestScalingConfiguration：移出最早伸缩配置创建的ECS实例。
OldestScalingConfiguration中提到的伸缩配置泛指组内实例配置信息来源，包括伸缩配置和启动模板
parameters.name: removal_policy_2

parameters.help_en:
The third scale-in policy used to remove ECS instances from the scaling group. Valid values:

OldestInstance: removes the ECS instances that were added to the scaling group at the earliest point in time.
NewestInstance: removes the ECS instances that were added to the scaling group at the latest point in time.
OldestScalingConfiguration: removes the ECS instances that were created based on the earliest scaling configuration.

The scaling configuration mentioned in OldestScalingConfiguration refers to the instance configuration source in the scaling group, which includes scaling configurations and launch templates
parameters.help_zh:
指定移出ECS实例的第三段伸缩组策略。取值范围：

OldestInstance：移出最早加入伸缩组的ECS实例。
NewestInstance：移出最新加入伸缩组的ECS实例。
OldestScalingConfiguration：移出最早伸缩配置创建的ECS实例。

OldestScalingConfiguration中提到的伸缩配置泛指组内实例配置信息来源，包括伸缩配置和启动模板
parameters.name: removal_policy_3

parameters.help_en: The ID of the active scaling configuration in the scaling group
parameters.help_zh: 伸缩组内生效的伸缩配置的ID
parameters.name: active_scaling_configuration_id

parameters.help_en:
The health check mode of the scaling group. Valid values:

NONE: disables health checks.
ECS: performs health checks on instances in the scaling group. This value is used to enable instance health checks for both ECS and ECI scaling groups.
LOAD_BALANCER: determines the health status of instances based on the health check results of load balancing. Classic Load Balancer (CLB) is not supported.

Default value: ECS.

To enable both instance health checks and load balancing health checks, use the `HealthCheckTypes` parameter
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩组的健康检查方式。取值范围：

NONE：不做健康检查。
ECS：对伸缩组内的实例做健康检查（ECS类型和ECI类型的伸缩组均使用本取值开启实例健康检查）。
LOAD_BALANCER: 根据负载均衡（暂不支持CLB负载均衡类型）健康检查结果判断实例健康状态。

默认值：ECS。

如果需要同时开启实例健康检查和负载均衡健康检查，请使用`HealthCheckTypes`参数
parameters.name: health_check_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance launch template. This parameter is used to specify the launch template from which the scaling group obtains launch configuration information
parameters.help_zh: 实例启动模板ID，用于指定伸缩组从实例启动模板获取启动配置信息
parameters.name: launch_template_id

parameters.help_en:
The version of the instance launch template. Valid values:
         
A specific template version number.
Default: always uses the default version of the template.
Latest: always uses the latest version of the template
parameters.help_zh:
实例启动模板的版本。取值范围：
         
固定的模板版本号。
Default：始终使用模板默认版本。
Latest：始终使用模板最新版本
parameters.name: launch_template_version

parameters.help_en:
The minimum number of pay-as-you-go instances required in the scaling group. Valid values: 0 to 1000. When the number of pay-as-you-go instances is less than this value, pay-as-you-go instances are preferentially created.

Default value: 0 when the `MultiAZPolicy` parameter is set to `COMPOSABLE`
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩组所需要按量实例个数的最小值，取值范围：0~1000。当按量实例个数少于该值时，将优先创建按量实例。

当`MultiAZPolicy`参数取值为`COMPOSABLE`策略时，默认值为0
parameters.name: on_demand_base_capacity

parameters.help_en:
The percentage of pay-as-you-go instances among the instances that exceed the minimum number of pay-as-you-go instances (OnDemandBaseCapacity) in the scaling group. Valid values: 0 to 100.

Default value: 100 when the `MultiAZPolicy` parameter is set to `COMPOSABLE`
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩组满足最小按量实例数（OnDemandBaseCapacity）要求后，超出的实例中按量实例应占的比例，取值范围：0～100。

当`MultiAZPolicy`参数取值为`COMPOSABLE`策略时，默认值为100
parameters.name: on_demand_percentage_above_base_capacity

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the spot instance replenishment feature. After this feature is enabled, when the scaling group receives a system message indicating that a spot instance will be reclaimed, the scaling group attempts to create a new instance to replace the spot instance to be reclaimed
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启补齐抢占式实例。开启后，当收到抢占式实例将被回收的系统消息时，伸缩组将尝试创建新的实例，替换掉将被回收的抢占式实例
parameters.name: spot_instance_remedy

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically attempt to create pay-as-you-go instances to meet the required number of ECS instances when the `MultiAZPolicy` parameter in the `CreateScalingGroup` operation is set to `COST_OPTIMIZED` and sufficient spot instances cannot be created due to price or inventory reasons. Valid values:

true: allows the creation of pay-as-you-go instances.
false: does not allow the creation of pay-as-you-go instances
parameters.help_zh:
当`CreateScalingGroup`接口的`MultiAZPolicy`取值为`COST_OPTIMIZED`时，如果因价格、库存等原因无法创建足够的抢占式实例，是否允许自动尝试创建按量实例满足ECS实例数量要求。取值范围：

true：允许。
false：不允许
parameters.name: compensate_with_on_demand

parameters.help_en:
The number of available instance types. The scaling group evenly creates spot instances based on the most cost-effective instance types. Valid values: 0 to 10.

Default value: 2 when the `MultiAZPolicy` parameter is set to `COMPOSABLE`
parameters.help_zh:
指定可用实例规格的个数，伸缩组将按成本最低的多个规格均衡创建抢占式实例。取值范围：0~10。

当`MultiAZPolicy`参数取值为`COMPOSABLE`策略时，默认值为2
parameters.name: spot_instance_pools

parameters.help_en:
The expected number of ECS or ECI instances in the scaling group. Setting this parameter enables the expected number of instances feature, and the scaling group automatically maintains the number of ECS or ECI instances at the expected value. Valid values: MinSize to MaxSize.

If the expected number of instances feature is disabled and then re-enabled, you must reset the `DesiredCapacity` value
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩组内ECS实例或ECI实例的期望数量。设置该参数意味着开启了期望实例数功能，伸缩组会自动将ECS实例或ECI实例数量维持在期望实例数。取值范围：MaxSize≥期望实例数量≥MinSize。
如果期望实例数功能关闭后又重新开启，则您需要重新设置`DesiredCapacity`值
parameters.name: desired_capacity

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable deletion protection for the scaling group. Valid values:

true: enables deletion protection for the scaling group. The scaling group cannot be deleted.
false: disables deletion protection for the scaling group
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启伸缩组删除保护。取值范围：

true：开启伸缩组删除保护，此时不能删除该伸缩组。
false：关闭伸缩组删除保护
parameters.name: group_deletion_protection

parameters.help_en:
The scaling policy for ECS instances in a multi-zone scaling group. Valid values:
         
PRIORITY: scales instances based on the priority of vSwitches (VSwitchIds.N). Auto Scaling preferentially attempts to scale instances in the zone where the vSwitch with the highest priority resides. If the scaling fails, Auto Scaling automatically attempts to scale instances in the zone of the vSwitch with the next highest priority.

COST_OPTIMIZED: during scale-out, Auto Scaling attempts to create ECS instances in ascending order of vCPU unit price. During scale-in, Auto Scaling attempts to remove ECS instances in descending order of vCPU unit price. If the scaling configuration settings include multiple instance types with spot billing methods, spot instances are preferentially created. You can use the `CompensateWithOnDemand` parameter to specify whether Auto Scaling is to automatically attempt to create pay-as-you-go instances when spot instances cannot be created.

    > COST_OPTIMIZED takes effect only when the scaling configuration settings specify multiple instance types or use spot instances.

BALANCE: evenly allocates ECS instances across the multiple zones specified in the scaling group. If the instances become unbalanced across zones due to insufficient inventory, you can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/71516.html operation to balance the resources.
COMPOSABLE: a composable policy that allows you to combine the preceding multi-zone scaling policies for ECS instances as needed
parameters.help_zh:
多可用区伸缩组ECS实例扩缩容策略。取值范围：
         
PRIORITY：根据虚拟交换机（VSwitchIds.N）的优先级进行扩缩容。弹性伸缩优先在优先级最高的交换机所在可用区尝试扩缩容，如果无法扩缩容，则自动在下一优先级的交换机所在可用区进行扩缩容。

COST_OPTIMIZED：扩容时弹性伸缩按vCPU单价从低到高尝试创建ECS实例，缩容时按vCPU单价从高到低尝试移出ECS实例。当伸缩配置设置了抢占式计费方式的多实例规格时，优先创建对应抢占式实例。您可以继续通过`CompensateWithOnDemand`参数，指定弹性伸缩在无法创建抢占式实例时，是否自动尝试创建按量付费实例。

    > COST_OPTIMIZED仅在伸缩配置设置了多实例规格或者选用了抢占式实例的情况下生效。

BALANCE：在伸缩组指定的多可用区之间均匀分配ECS实例。如果由于库存不足等原因可用区之间变得不平衡，您可以通过API https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/71516.html平衡资源。
COMPOSABLE：是一种组合策略，您可以根据需要自主组合上述多可用区伸缩组ECS实例的扩缩容策略
parameters.name: multi_az_policy

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of one or more vSwitches.

This parameter takes effect only when the network type of the scaling group is VPC. The VPC to which the specified vSwitches belong must be the same as the VPC to which the scaling group belongs.

The vSwitches can belong to multiple zones. The priority of vSwitches is sorted in ascending numerical order, where 1 indicates the highest priority. When ECS instances cannot be created in the zone of a vSwitch with a higher priority, the vSwitch with the next highest priority is automatically selected to create ECS instances
parameters.help_zh:
一台或多台虚拟交换机的ID。

只有当伸缩组网络类型为VPC时，当前参数才生效。指定虚拟交换机所属的VPC必须和伸缩组所属的VPC相同。

虚拟交换机可以来自多个可用区。虚拟交换机的优先级按照数字升序排序，1表示最高优先级。当优先级较高的虚拟交换机所在可用区无法创建ECS实例时，自动选择下一优先级的虚拟交换机创建ECS实例
parameters.name: vswitchids

fields.help_en:
When you need the scaling group to scale based on instance type capacity, specify both this parameter and LaunchTemplateOverride.N.WeightedCapacity.

This parameter is used to specify the instance type and overrides the instance type in the launch template. You can specify N values for this parameter to extend the launch template to support N instance types. N ranges from 1 to 20.

This parameter takes effect only when the LaunchTemplateId parameter is specified.

Valid values for InstanceType: available ECS instance types. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25378.html
fields.help_zh:
当您需要伸缩组按照实例规格容量进行伸缩时，请同时指定本参数和LaunchTemplateOverride.N.WeightedCapacity。

本参数用于指定实例规格，会覆盖启动模板中的实例规格。您可以指定N个本参数，扩展启动模板支持N个实例规格。N的取值范围：1~20。
仅当LaunchTemplateId参数指定了启动模板时，本参数生效。

InstanceType的取值范围：在售的ECS实例规格，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25378.html
fields.name: instance_type

fields.help_en:
This parameter is used to specify the maximum spot price for the instance type overridden in the launch template (namely, `LaunchTemplateOverride.N.InstanceType`). You can specify N values for this parameter to extend the launch template to support N instance types. N ranges from 1 to 20.

This parameter takes effect only when the `LaunchTemplateId` parameter is specified
fields.help_zh:
本参数用于指定实例启动模板覆盖规格（即`LaunchTemplateOverride.N.InstanceType`）的竞价价格上限。您可以指定N个该参数，扩展启动模板支持N个实例规格。N的取值范围：1~20。
仅当`LaunchTemplateId`参数指定了启动模板时，该参数才生效
fields.name: spot_price_limit

fields.help_en:
When you need the scaling group to scale based on instance type capacity, specify this parameter after specifying LaunchTemplateOverride.N.InstanceType. The two parameters correspond to each other, and N must be consistent.

This parameter is used to specify the weight of the instance type, which indicates the capacity represented by a single instance of the instance type in the scaling group.
A larger weight means fewer instances of this instance type are required to meet the expected capacity.

Because performance metrics such as the number of vCPUs and memory size vary among instance types, you can configure different weights for different instance types based on your needs.

Example:

Current capacity: 0.
Expected capacity: 6.
Capacity of the ecs.c5.xlarge instance type: 4.

To meet the expected capacity, the scaling group scales out by adding two ecs.c5.xlarge instances.

During scale-out, the capacity of the scaling group cannot exceed the sum of the maximum capacity (MaxSize) and the maximum weight of the instance types.

Valid values for WeightedCapacity: 1 to 500
fields.help_zh:
当您需要伸缩组按照实例规格容量进行伸缩时，在指定LaunchTemplateOverride.N.InstanceType后，再指定本参数。两个参数一一对应，N需要保持一致。

本参数用于指定实例规格的权重，即实例规格的单台实例在伸缩组中表示的容量大小。
权重越大，满足期望容量所需的本实例规格的实例数量越少。

由于每个实例规格的vCPU个数、内存大小等性能指标会有差异，您可以根据自身需求，给不同的实例规格配置不同的权重。

 例如：

当前容量：0。
期望容量：6。
ecs.c5.xlarge规格容量：4。

为满足期望容量，伸缩组将为用户扩容2台ecs.c5.xlarge实例。

扩容时伸缩组的容量不得超过最大容量（MaxSize）与实例规格的最大权重之和。

WeightedCapacity的取值范围：1~500
fields.name: weighted_capacity

parameters.help_en: The launch template information
parameters.help_zh: 启动模板信息
parameters.name: launch_template_override

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the capacity of the scaling group is evenly distributed across multiple zones. This parameter takes effect only when the `MultiAZPolicy` parameter is set to `COMPOSABLE`. Valid values:

true: the capacity of the scaling group is evenly distributed across multiple zones.
false: the capacity of the scaling group is not evenly distributed across multiple zones.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩组的容量是否在多个可用区间均衡分布（仅当`MultiAZPolicy`参数取值为`COMPOSABLE`策略时生效），取值范围：
true：伸缩组的容量在多个可用区间均衡分布。
false：伸缩组的容量不在多个可用区间均衡分布。

默认值：false
parameters.name: az_balance

parameters.help_en:
The capacity allocation strategy, which determines how the scaling group selects available instance types to meet the capacity requirements. The capacity distribution strategy applies to both pay-as-you-go and spot capacities. This parameter takes effect only when the `MultiAZPolicy` parameter is set to `COMPOSABLE`. Valid values:

priority: creates instances in the order of the configured instance types.
lowestPrice: creates instances in ascending order of the vCPU unit price of the instance types.

Default value: priority
parameters.help_zh:
容量分配策略，决定了伸缩组如何选择可用的实例规格类型满足容量。容量分布策略同时对按量和抢占式容量生效（仅当`MultiAZPolicy`参数取值为`COMPOSABLE`策略时生效）。取值范围：

priority：按照配置的实例规格的顺序创建实例。
lowestPrice：按照实例规格单位vCpu价格从低到高创建实例。

默认值：priority
parameters.name: allocation_strategy

parameters.help_en:
The spot capacity distribution strategy. You can use this parameter to separately specify the distribution strategy for spot capacity. This parameter takes effect only when the `MultiAZPolicy` parameter is set to `COMPOSABLE`. Valid values:

priority: creates instances in the order of the configured instance types.
lowestPrice: creates instances in ascending order of the vCPU unit price of the instance types.

Default value: priority
parameters.help_zh:
抢占式容量分布策略。您可以通过该参数单独指定抢占式容量的分布策略（仅当`MultiAZPolicy`参数取值为`COMPOSABLE`策略时生效）。取值范围：

priority：按照配置的实例规格的顺序创建实例。
lowestPrice：按照实例规格单位vCpu价格从低到高创建实例。

默认值：priority
parameters.name: spot_allocation_strategy

parameters.help_en:
The maximum lifetime of an instance in the scaling group. Unit: seconds.

Valid values: 0 or `[86400, Integer.maxValue]`. A value of 0 indicates that the previously configured MaxInstanceLifetime value is cleared (namely, MaxInstanceLifetime is not set).

Default value: null.

This parameter is not supported for ECI scaling groups or scaling groups with the no fees for stopped instances feature enabled
parameters.help_zh:
实例在伸缩组中存活的最大时间。单位为秒。

取值范围：0或`[86400, Integer.maxValue]`。其中，0表示清空MaxInstanceLifetime设置过的值（即未设置MaxInstanceLifetime值）。

默认值：null。

ECI类型的伸缩组或停机不收费的伸缩组不支持设置该参数
parameters.name: max_instance_lifetime

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the Function Compute function for the custom scale-in policy. This parameter takes effect only when the first removal policy in RemovalPolicies is set to CustomPolicy
parameters.help_zh: 自定义缩容策略Function函数ARN。仅当RemovalPolicies配置第一个移除策略为CustomPolicy时生效
parameters.name: custom_policy_arn

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to disable the expected number of instances feature for the scaling group. Valid values:

false: enables the expected number of instances feature.
true: disables the expected number of instances feature.

You can set this parameter to true (disable the expected number of instances feature) only when no scaling activity is in progress in the scaling group. The current `DesiredCapacity` property of the scaling group is also cleared, but the current number of instances in the scaling group remains unchanged
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩组是否关闭期望实例数功能。取值范围：
false：启用期望实例数功能。
true：关闭期望实例数功能。
只有伸缩组当前无伸缩活动时，才能将该参数设置为true（即伸缩组的期望实例数功能关闭），伸缩组当前的`DesiredCapacity`属性也会被清空，但伸缩组中当前的实例数量不发生变化
parameters.name: disable_desired_capacity

parameters.help_en:
The reclaim mode of the scaling group. Valid values:

recycle: the shutdown and reclaim mode.

release: the release mode.

forcerelease: the force release mode.

    > If you select `forcerelease`, the system forcibly releases `Running` instances during scale-in activities. Forcibly releasing an instance is equivalent to a power-off operation, which erases temporary data in the memory and storage of the instance. The data cannot be recovered. Proceed with caution.

forcerecycle: the force shutdown and reclaim mode.

    > If you select `forcerecycle`, the system forcibly shuts down `Running` instances during scale-in activities. Forcibly shutting down an instance is equivalent to a power-off operation, which erases temporary data in the memory and storage of the instance. The data cannot be recovered. Proceed with caution.

The ScalingPolicy parameter specifies the reclaim mode of the scaling group, but the specific action taken when an instance is removed from the scaling group is determined by the RemovePolicy parameter in the RemoveInstances operation. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25955.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定伸缩组的回收模式。取值范围：

recycle：伸缩组的回收模式为停机回收模式。

release：伸缩组的回收模式为释放模式。

forcerelease：伸缩组的回收模式为强制释放模式。

    >选择`forcerelease`后，在弹性收缩活动中系统会强制释放`运行中`（Running）的实例。强制释放实例相当于断电操作，会导致该实例内存以及存储中的临时数据被擦除，数据无法恢复，请您谨慎选择。

forcerecycle：伸缩组的回收模式为强制停机回收模式。

    >选择`forcerecycle`后，在弹性收缩活动中系统会强制关机`运行中`（Running）的实例。强制关机相当于断电操作，会导致该实例内存以及存储中的临时数据被擦除，数据无法恢复，请您谨慎选择。

ScalingPolicy指定伸缩组的回收模式，但实例被移出伸缩组时的具体动作，由RemoveInstances的RemovePolicy参数决定，更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25955.html
parameters.name: scaling_policy

parameters.help_en:
The health check modes of the scaling group.

You can use this parameter to set multiple values and enable multiple health check options. If the `HealthCheckType` parameter is set, this parameter is ignored
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩组的健康检查方式。
使用此参数可以设置多个值，开启多个健康检查选项。如果设置了`HealthCheckType`参数，则本参数将被忽略
parameters.name: health_check_types

parameters.help_en:
The timeout period for waiting for an ECS instance to be successfully stopped during the scale-in process. Unit: seconds.
Valid values: 30 to 240.

This parameter takes effect only during the scale-in process when ScalingPolicy is set to the release mode.  
If this parameter is set, the system waits for a maximum of the StopInstanceTimeout period for the instance to be successfully stopped. If the timeout period expires, the scale-in process continues regardless of whether the instance is successfully stopped.  
If this parameter is not set, the system waits for a long time for the instance to be successfully stopped. The scale-in process continues only after the instance is successfully stopped. If the instance fails to be stopped, the scale-in process rolls back and the scale-in fails.
Setting this parameter to 0 indicates that the parameter settings are canceled
parameters.help_zh:
缩容流程中等待ECS实例停机成功的超时时间，单位为秒。
取值范围：30~240。

该参数仅在 ScalingPolicy = release 模式下的缩容流程里生效。  
如果设置了该参数，系统会最长等待StopInstanceTimeout时间将实例停机成功，超时后无论实例是否成功停机都会继续缩容。  
如果没有设置该参数，系统会长时间等待实例停机成功，只有实例停机成功后才继续缩容，停机失败时，缩容流程会回滚，缩容失败。
该参数设置为0时，表示取消该参数配置
parameters.name: stop_instance_timeout

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically attempt to create pay-as-you-go instances to meet the required number of ECS instances when the `MultiAZPolicy` parameter in the `CreateScalingGroup` operation is set to `COST_OPTIMIZED` and sufficient spot instances cannot be created due to price or inventory reasons. Valid values:

true: allows the creation of pay-as-you-go instances.
false: does not allow the creation of pay-as-you-go instances
fields.help_zh:
当`CreateScalingGroup`接口的`MultiAZPolicy`取值为`COST_OPTIMIZED`时，如果因价格、库存等原因无法创建足够的抢占式实例，是否允许自动尝试创建按量实例满足ECS实例数量要求。取值范围：

true：允许。
false：不允许
fields.name: compensate_with_on_demand

fields.help_en:
The minimum number of pay-as-you-go instances required in the existing scaling group. When the number of pay-as-you-go instances in the scaling group is less than this value, the system preferentially creates pay-as-you-go instances. Valid values: 0 to 1000.

Default value: 0 when the `MultiAZPolicy` parameter is set to `COMPOSABLE`
fields.help_zh:
已有伸缩组内所需要的按量实例数的最小值，当伸缩组内按量实例个数少于该值时，系统将优先创建按量实例。取值范围：0~1000。

当`MultiAZPolicy`参数取值为`COMPOSABLE`策略时，默认值为0
fields.name: on_demand_base_capacity

fields.help_en:
The percentage of pay-as-you-go instances among the instances that exceed the minimum number of pay-as-you-go instances (`OnDemandBaseCapacity`) in the scaling group. Valid values: 0 to 100.

Default value: 100 when the `MultiAZPolicy` parameter is set to `COMPOSABLE`
fields.help_zh:
伸缩组满足最小按量实例数`OnDemandBaseCapacity`要求后，超出的实例中按量实例应占的比例。取值范围：0～100。

当`MultiAZPolicy`参数取值为`COMPOSABLE`策略时，默认值为100
fields.name: on_demand_percentage_above_base_capacity

fields.help_en:
The price comparison mode for the cost optimization strategy of the scaling group. Valid values:

PricePerUnit: compares prices based on the price per unit of capacity.

  The capacity of an instance in the scaling group is equal to the weight set for the instance type. The default weight is 1, meaning one ECS instance occupies a capacity of 1.

PricePerVCpu: compares prices based on the price per vCPU.

Default value: PricePerUnit
fields.help_zh:
伸缩组成本优化策略的比价模式。取值范围：

PricePerUnit：使用每单位容量价格比价。

  实例在伸缩组中容量大小等于为实例规格设置的权重，默认为1，即一台ECS所占容量为1。

PricePerVCpu：使用每单位vCpu价格进行比价。

默认值：PricePerUnit
fields.name: price_comparison_mode

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to attempt to use spot instances to replace pay-as-you-go capacity when `CompensateWithOnDemand` is enabled and the proportion of pay-as-you-go instances exceeds the `OnDemandPercentageAboveBaseCapacity` percentage. In common scenarios where `CompensateWithOnDemand` downgrades spot instances to pay-as-you-go instances due to spot inventory or price reasons, this feature attempts to use spot instances to replace the excess pay-as-you-go capacity to avoid the long-term existence of pay-as-you-go instances. Valid values:

true: allows the replacement.
false: does not allow the replacement.

Default value: false
fields.help_zh:
当开启`CompensateWithOnDemand`后，如果按量比例超过`OnDemandPercentageAboveBaseCapacity`比例时，会尝试使用spot替换按量容量。常见场景`CompensateWithOnDemand`因Spot库存或价格原因导致Spot降级按量实例，为避免按量实例长时间存在，尝试使用Spot替换多余的按量容量。取值范围：

true：允许。
false：不允许。

默认值：false
fields.name: spot_auto_replace_on_demand

parameters.help_en: The capacity options
parameters.help_zh: 容量选项
parameters.name: capacity_options

parameters.help_en:
The zone balancing mode. This parameter takes effect only when the zone balancing mode is enabled. Valid values:
 
BalancedBestEffort: when resource creation fails in a zone, the system degrades to other zones to ensure best-effort delivery of resources.

BalancedOnly: when resource creation fails in a zone, the system does not degrade to other zones. The scale-out activity partially succeeds to avoid excessive imbalance of resources across different zones.

Default value: BalancedBestEffort
parameters.help_zh:
可用区均衡模式，仅当开启可用区均衡模式时生效。取值范围：
 
BalancedBestEffort：
当某可用区资源创建失败时，会降级至其他可用区，保障资源的尽力交付。

BalancedOnly：
当某可用区资源创建失败时，不会降级至其他可用区，扩容活动部分成功，避免资源在不同可用区过度不均衡。

默认值：BalancedBestEffort
parameters.name: balance_mode

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic balancing for the scaling group. This parameter takes effect only when BalancedOnly is enabled for the zone-balanced scaling group. Valid values:

false: disables automatic balancing for the scaling group.
true: enables automatic balancing for the scaling group. The scaling group automatically detects the capacity across zones. When the capacity is unbalanced across zones, the scaling group proactively scales instances across zones to rebalance the capacity.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启伸缩组自动均衡，仅当可用区均衡伸缩组开启了BalancedOnly才生效。取值范围：
false：不开启伸缩组自动均衡。
true：开启伸缩组自动均衡时，伸缩组会自动检测可用区见容量，当可用区容量不均衡时，会主动进行可用区扩缩，进行可用区容量再均衡。

默认值: false
parameters.name: auto_rebalance

fields.help_en:
The health check behavior in impaired zones. Valid values: 

ReplaceUnhealthy: normally replaces unhealthy instances in all zones. 
IgnoreUnhealthy: does not replace unhealthy instances in the impaired zone. Healthy zones are not affected
fields.help_zh:
受损可用区的健康检查行为。取值范围： 

ReplaceUnhealthy：所有可用区的不健康实例正常替换。 
IgnoreUnhealthy：不替换受损可用区内的不健康实例，健康可用区不受影响
fields.name: impaired_zone_health_check_behavior

fields.help_en:
Blocks scale-in activities triggered by specified types of scaling rules (the blocking scope is all zones under the scaling group, not just the impaired zones) to prevent false scale-in caused by fake improvement of monitoring metrics due to unreachable instances in the impaired zone. Valid values: 

StepScalingRule: blocks scale-in triggered by step scaling rules. 
TargetTrackingScalingRule: blocks scale-in triggered by target tracking scaling rules. 
None: does not block scale-in
fields.help_zh:
阻断指定类型的伸缩规则触发的缩容（阻断范围为整个伸缩组下可用区，非仅受损可用区），防止受损可用区内实例不可达导致监控指标假性改善而误缩容。取值范围： 

StepScalingRule：阻断步进伸缩规则触发的缩容。 
TargetTrackingScalingRule：阻断目标追踪伸缩规则触发的缩容。 
None：不阻断
fields.name: scale_in_blocked_rule_types

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether scale-out creates instances only in healthy zones during zone shift. Valid values: 

true: creates instances only in healthy zones during scale-out (skips impaired zones). 
false: does not restrict zones, and scale-out can create instances in any zone under the scaling group
fields.help_zh:
转移生效期间，扩容是否仅在健康可用区创建实例。取值范围： 

true：扩容仅在健康可用区创建实例（跳过受损可用区）。 
false：不限制可用区，扩容可创建实例至伸缩组下任意可用区
fields.name: scale_out_in_healthy_zones_only

parameters.help_en: The behavior policy of the scaling group during zone shift
parameters.help_zh: 可用区转移生效期间，伸缩组的行为策略
parameters.name: zone_shift_policy
